# USA Attachments

USA Attachments is a manufacturer of heavy equipment attachments based in King, NC.  
Our attachments are made in the USA using some global materials.  
Open hours: **8AM – 5PM EST**

If you need help choosing the right attachment, call **1-800-870-3610**.

Website: [https://www.excavatorthumb.com](https://www.excavatorthumb.com)

## Product API

You can look up any product by its model name using our API:

`GET /api/product/{name}`

Example: `https://www.excavatorthumb.com/api/product/eb5024`

Returns JSON with product details including price, weight, stock, shipping info, category, and subcategory when available.
